text:
```yaml
name: Claude Code Review

on:
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]
  pull_request_review_comment:
    types: [created]

jobs:
  claude-code:
    if: contains(github.event.comment.body, '@claude')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
      issues: write
    steps:
      - name: Check user permissions
        if: github.event.comment.author_association != 'OWNER' && github.event.comment.author_association != 'MEMBER' && github.event.comment.author_association != 'COLLABORATOR'
        run: |
          echo "User does not have write access. Exiting."
          exit 1
      - name: Run Claude Code
        uses: anthropic/claude-code@v1
        with:
          api-key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
```
